name: Passing develop commit deploys immutable staging images
preconditions: Protected develop/environment; dedicated runner; registry and private config
input: Reviewed develop merge with all five check jobs passing
expected_result: Commit-tagged GHCR images deploy by digest; environment-specific config and readiness pass; rejected PR/other branch/superseded candidates cannot deploy

name: Failure preserves data and restores last healthy application
type: isolated recovery and real staging drill
preconditions: Recorded healthy release and retained compatible schema/config/digests
input: Schema approval failure; pull/readiness/smoke failure; failed recovery; first deployment failure
expected_result: Preflight leaves old application untouched; post-apply failure restores previous healthy release or reports operator-required; job fails; no data or volume deletion

name: Traceable sanitized outcome and login/API smoke
preconditions: HTTPS gateway/frontend; dedicated changed-password synthetic manager
input: Readiness/login/session/authenticated API/logout/anonymous denial; inspect summary and artifact
expected_result: Expected HTTP responses and safe cookie flags; SHA/digests/stage/outcome traceable; no secrets in published output
